title: See what is happening
purpose: Walk a visitor through: See what is happening.
visitor_questions: See what is happening?
How do I see what is happening?
Where is that on my phone?
answer: Calendar in the top menu opens the events list. You can switch months in The Events Calendar. Open a title for the description. Registering is the booking or ticket link on that event, or a call to the shop. On a phone: Calendar in the phone menu. Your Calendar under it is for bookings you already made, after you sign in. Direct link: https://shopsacredground.com/events/list/.

title: See bookings you already made
purpose: Walk a visitor through: See bookings you already made.
visitor_questions: See bookings you already made?
How do I see bookings you already made?
Where is that on my phone?
answer: Calendar, then Your Calendar. Sign in with the same email you booked with. Upcoming and past are the two tabs. Reschedule or cancel as early as you can. Less than 24 hours' notice is not eligible for a refund. Questions: 847-749-3922. On a phone: Calendar, then Your Calendar. Same sign-in. Direct link: https://shopsacredground.com/your-calendar/.

title: Not sure where to start
purpose: Walk a visitor through: Not sure where to start.
visitor_questions: Not sure where to start?
How do I not sure where to start?
Where is that on my phone?
answer: Ask what they are carrying, or what they are curious about. Shop if they want to wander. Practitioners if they want a person. Library if they want to read. Observatory if they want the moon, a stone, or a number. Calendar if they want to see the week. Phone if they want a human: 847-749-3922. On a phone: Same destinations. Give the direct link. Direct link: https://shopsacredground.com/.
